author: reek
body: Append-only, CRC-framed mutation log for annotation operations. Every mutation (annotate, discuss, retract) is recorded as a log entry with its depot CL at time of write. The log is the source of truth; JSON sidecars are materialized views.

author: reek
body: To log-empty gives an empty MutationLog. To log-append gives a MutationLog with a new entry appended. To log-entries gives the list of all entries in append order. To log-entry-count gives the number of entries. To log-is-stale gives True when entries exist with depot-cl older than the given CL. To log-since gives entries appended after the given sequence number. To log-replay gives an AnnotationStore rebuilt by replaying all entries.
